Your real shrine: the input
Tap the paper card here, as always.
The headset anchors to it (2 taps).
Tap → summon beam
shrine → lane: a 600 ms arc, then the
figure rises. Spectacle a 2.8" screen
can't give; driven by the SSE diff.
Mine are OBJECTS
12 cm lit figures, gear visible, stat
plate on the base facing me. Pointable.
Theirs are ENTRIES
low carved plinths + faction rim; one
billboard tag, smaller than my plates.
Crest ♛ on both commanders.
Castles stand at the board's ends
life floats above; the tower cracks
at 10 and 5 (view-diffed, no new field).
World-locked readouts
pinned above your own shrine. No HUD
glued to your face; nothing to lose.
Tapstone VR — the table, seat 0, passthrough (Quest Pro colour; Quest 2 is greyscale)
mock · proportions from a real projection: 60×42 cm board, shrines 90 cm apart, head 45 cm over the table
